kp_title: Identifying Regular and Irregular Singular Points
raw_html:
1.Identifying Regular and Irregular Singular Points?

(x2−4)y″+5xy′+sin⁡(x)y=0 Consider the differential equation given above. Which of the following statements are true?

  1. The functions P(x)=5xx2−4 and Q(x)=sin⁡(x)x2−4 are analytic about x=2.
  2. The functions (x−2)P(x) and (x−2)2Q(x) are analytic about x=2.
  3. The point x=2 is an irregular singular point of the differential equation.
E
